title: HASP driver settings for CLO offline-auth products
content: ## **The Latest HASP driver download (updated June 2022)** * Mac: <https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/Sentinel_Runtime_94691.tar> * Linux: <https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/aksusbd-8.31.1.tar> * Windows: <https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/haspdinst_8_31.exe> **Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on Windows ** **Objective** The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Sentinel HASP Driver which is suitable for your operating system. ** Operation** **Installing Sentinel Driver on Windows** 1. Download the latest HASP driver (See above) 2. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to install the driver. 3. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-i" behind the automatically entered path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to install. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000773648) 4. Access to [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/) and check to see if the following screen appears to see if the HASP Driver has been successfully installed. If the following screen appears, then installation is successful. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000727667) 5. If the following error occurs, the HASP Driver must be deleted and reinstalled. HASP Driver Deletion ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000727627) ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000727647)[ ](http://krmanual.clo3d.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=3375386) **Deleting Sentinel Driver on Windows ** 1. Download the latest HASP driver (see above) ** ** 2. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to delete the driver. ![22.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000410027) 3. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-purge -r" behind the corresponding path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to delete. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000774248) 4. After the driver has been successfully deleted, refer to the following content to reinstall the driver. HASP Driver Installation **Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on MAC ** **Objective** The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Mac OS Sentinel HASP Driver. ** Operation** **Installing Sentinel Driver on Mac ** * Download the latest HASP driver (see above) * ver 21.0 Build 77815 Sentinel Driver for Mac Supported Platforms: Mac OS X 10.9.x, 10.10.x, 10.11.x, 10.12.x, 10.13.x [https://s3.clo3d.com/sentinel/7.80/Sentinel_Runtime.dmg](https://s3.clo3d.com/sentinel/7.80/Sentinel_Runtime.dmg) * macOS Catalina 10.15 users, please download Sentinel Driver here <https://s3.clo3d.com/sentinel/Sentinel_Runtime.dmg> 1. Please remove all the dongle keys inserted into the Mac PC installation to be done. 2. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" (ver 21.0 Build 77815) ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000781588) 3. Double-click the **Install Sentinel Runtime Environment** icon. 4. Please allow the 'hasplmd' application to accept incoming network connections (this message may not appear). 5. Access to [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/)** ** 6. If you are unable to connect to the URL, try again after 10 seconds later. If it still does not work, reboot and connect again. If the solutions above do not work, please go back to the first step and check again. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000730047) *If you click **Diagnostics** , License Manager Version appears with newly installed version; ver 21.0 Build 77815 (Version information of 21.0 Build 77815 appears as this in Diagnostics). ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000781668) 7. Insert Dongle key into USB port. 8. If the Dongle key appears in 'Sentinel Keys', the installation is successfully done. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000781628) **Reinstalling Sentinel on Mac ** 1. Please remove all the dongle keys from USB port. 2. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" with version of "ver 21.0 Build 77815". ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000783728) 3. Double-click **Uninstall Sentinel Runtime Environment**. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000783688) 4. Click **Uninstall**. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000783708) 5. If the un-installation is done normally, the dialog above appears. Please press **OK** button and then click **Quit**. 6. Reboot your Mac. 7. Install Sentinel Driver. Please refer to the following method; Reinstall Sentinel Driver on Mac *If you don't follow the guideline, you may not be able to find Dongle keys inserted into your PC or other PCs. Also the other PCs may not be able to find your Dongle key. **Sentinel Driver Known Bugs ** * Sentinel LDK Protection System Error : invalid XML scope (36) Normally occurred when operating in CLO3D modelist network dongle 1.4.14.7701 (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 6.4 version or before 6.4). * Occurs with the following conditions: → Network Dongle key (not a local Dongle key) → CLO3D Modelist Network with 2.1.44 or later version. (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 7.1) → The Dongle key is inserted into another PC. → The version of Sentinel Driver is 13.20 in your Mac. → Operates normally after reinstalling with Mac Sentinel Driver ver 16.0. * If multiple Sentinel Drivers are mounted, the software is unable to find virtual files. If a driver is already mounted, please demount(or eject) it and mount new driver. * Sentinel Driver starts to operate in a few seconds. On occasion, it does not start. In that case, please reboot your PC. * All the Dongle keys should be removed when uninstalling Sentinel Driver. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000784048) Go Back to the List of Contents
content_description: Download the latest Sentinel HASP driver for your operating system to resolve installation errors and ensure smooth operation of your software.

title: Property Editor
content: **List of Contents** Property Editor Simulation Properties **Objective** Edit selected item's properties in the Property Editor. **Operation** **Property Editor** **Pattern Property** | Shows a pattern’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected ---|--- **Internal Shape Property** | Shows an internal shape’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Sewing Property** | Shows a sewing line's property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Stitch Property** | Shows a stitch's property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Sewing Style Property** | Shows a sewing style’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Fabric Property** | Shows a pattern’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected from the fabric list. **Button Property** | Shows a button’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Buttonhole Property** | Shows a buttonhole’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Avatar Property** | Shows the pattern-related properties of an avatar on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Simulation Property** | Shows the simulation properties on the Property Editor. Right click on the 3D Pattern Window and select Simulation Property from the pop-up menu. **Wind Property** | Shows the wind properties on the Property Editor. Right click on the 3D Pattern Window and select Wind Property from the pop-up menu. **2D Window Property** | Shows the 2D Pattern Window properties on the Property Editor. Right click on the 2D Pattern Window and select 2D Pattern Window Property from the pop-up menu. **Simulation Property** 1. Follow and select the menu as below. Right-click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) ▶ **Simulation Properties** → Open, save, and edit properties related to Simulation in the Property Editor. **※ Note:** * **Select All with Same Property:** Right-click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Patterns) ▶ Select All with Same Property ▶ **Particle Distance** / **Layer** / **Fabric** → Patterns with the same property is selected. * **Calculator:** Right click on the numeric field to be edited and select **Calculator** option to calculate and apply desired result directly in CLO (ver4.2.0). ![calculator_en.gif](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003066328/calculator_en.gif) * To convert units, click the **Convert** option from the Calculator. When the Calculator changes to unit conversion calculator, type in the desired number, select appropriate units, and click = (equal sign). Then, the typed in value is converted to appropriate unit. To apply the result to the Property Editor, please select **OK** (ver4.2.0). When the converted unit mismatches with the program's unit, the value is applied as the program's unit, not the converted unit (ver4.2.0). * **Item No.:** In each item's Property Editor, insert its item number. (ver 5.2) Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for users to edit and manage various properties of selected items within the Property Editor in simulation software.

title: Fold Seam Line
content: ### **Objective** Use this function to create an pressing effect on sewn parts of Patterns. **Location** Pattern Property Editor ▶ Fold ▶ **Fold Angle** **Operation** 1. Click on ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005491927/Toolbar_Common_Sewing_Edit.png) **Edit Sewing** tool. 2. Select the seamline to change its fold angle. 3. Follow the indicated guideline below: Pattern Property Editor ▶ Fold ▶ **Fold Angle** 4. Adjust the value, in the range of 0~360˚. **※ Note:** * The value of fold angle is in between 0° to 360°, 180° represents a flat state. The internal line is folded towards the front of the pattern as the fold angle is closer to 0˚, and is folded into the back of the pattern as the angle is closer to 360˚. * **Fold Strength ** The intensity of the fold is able to be set by adjusting the value of **Fold Strength**. The higher the value, the closer the fold is to the set angle. When a jacket and its lining are sewn together, the sewn area inflates due to the default sewing angle and intensity values. In this case, sets the **Fold Strength** to 0 to flatten the sewn boundaries. * When the Sewing type is set as **Turned** , **Fold Strength** and **Fold Angle** cannot be modified (ver4.0.0).
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide for adjusting the fold angle and strength of sewn parts in pattern design, enhancing the visual and structural integrity of garment patterns.

title: Elastic
content: **List of Contents** Elastic Applicable Items Apply Elastic Simulation Elastic Strength Elastic Ratio Segment Length Total Length **Elastic** \- Apply Elastic to Pattern outlines and Internal Lines to shrink or stretch 3D Patterns. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021992087/mceclip0.png) **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar and select the Pattern outline or the Internal Line as desired. Then, navigate to the Property Editor and toggle on **Elastic.** ** Applicable Items** \- Elastic can be applied to all Pattern outlines. \- Elastic can be applied to all Internal Lines. **Apply Elastic** \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021992087/mceclip0.png) **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar and select the segment where Elastic should be applied to. \- Elastic can also be applied to a whole Pattern by selecting it with the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022194728/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool. \- Once the desired item is selected, navigate to the Property Editor and toggle on **Elastic.** \- Elastic will be applied to the selected items. **Simulation** \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022133907/mceclip1.png) Simulation tool from the 3D toolbar. \- The elastic will be applied to 3D Garments. **Elastic Strength** \- Elastic Strength refers to the Elastic resistance. \- The default value is 10. Greater the Elastic Strength is, lesser affected by outside influence and maintain Elastic Ratio. \- It is recommended to set the Elastic Strength to 10. **Elastic Ratio** \- Elastic Ratio indicates by what percentage the selected Pattern outlines or Internal Lines will shrink or stretch. \- 100% is the original length of the selected Pattern outlines or Internal Lines. Smaller the percentage is, shorter the length is. \- The Elastic Ratio can be adjusted between 0 and 200. **Segment Length** \- Type in the desired segment length of the selected Pattern outlines or Internal Lines after the Elastic is applied. \- The Elastic Ratio will be automatically calculated when the Segment Length is assigned. 。 **Total Length** \- Select multiple segments and type in the desired length for the sum of selected segments. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on applying and adjusting elastic properties to 3D garment patterns, including instructions on usage, settings, and effects on design.

title: Dart
content: **List of Contents** Dart Create Dart Create Dart with Specific Values **Dart** \- Create Dart on Patterns. Because Patterns can be sewn without seam allowances in CLO, Dart will be sewn with the Pattern outlines. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021854067/mceclip0.png) **Dart** tool from the 2D toolbar or navigate to and select Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Dart.** ** Create Dart** \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021854067/mceclip0.png) **Dart** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Navigate to the 2D window and click and drag within a Pattern. \- The preview of the Dart will appear. \- Release the mouse to complete the Dart. **Create Dart with Specific Values** \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021854067/mceclip0.png) **Dart** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Navigate to the 2D window and click once within a Pattern. \- The Create Dart window will appear. \- Enter desired values to the Create Dart window and select OK. * **Size** \- Assign Width (Left), Width (Right), Height (Up), and Height (Down) which are measured from the center of the Dart. * **Position** \- Assign the placement of the Dart. * **Outline** \- Enter Left, Right, Up, and Down values which indicate the margin between the Dart and the Pattern outline. * **Center** \- Enter Left, Right, Up, and Down values which are measured from the center of the Dart Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on creating and customizing darts in CLO 3D, detailing step-by-step instructions and specific value settings for optimal pattern design.

title: Create Smooth Curve
content: ### **Objective** Modify Pattern outlines or Internal Lines into smooth curves. ### **Location** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Smooth Curve** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![____________.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008231167/____________.png) **Smooth Curve** ### **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Smooth Curve** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![____________.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008231167/____________.png) **Smooth Curve ** 2. Click on a segment or point to establish the first point. → The point appears in grey. 3. Drag the mouse. → A grey arrow extending from the point follows the cursor. 4. Click on another segment or point to establish the endpoint. → A reference line is created between the two points. 5. With the reference line created, click on the side that will be converted into a smooth curve. → The entire side is highlighted in yellow. 6. Click & drag the reference line to create the desired smooth curve. → The entire outline of the selected side is replaced by the reference line. **※ 참조:** **Cancel Actions** * **Cancel All Actions** While using the ![____________.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008231167/____________.png) **Smooth Curve** tool, press Esc or Ctrl+Z on the keyboard and all actions are undone. * **Cancel Last Action** While using the ![____________.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008231167/____________.png) **Smooth Curve** tool, press Delete or Backspace on the keyboard and the last action is undone.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for modifying pattern outlines or internal lines into smooth curves using the Smooth Curve tool in the 2D Pattern editing menu.

title: Open/Save Arrangement Point
content: **Objective** Save newly created Arrangement Point, open and use previously saved Arrangement Points. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶ Arrangement ▶ Arrangement Point ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005661468/______.PNG)**Open** /![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005661488/______.PNG)**Save** ** Operation** **Open** 1. title: Avatar (AVT) Open/Add/Save
content: **List of Contents** **Open/Add Avatar** **Save Avatar** **Objective** Model (*.dae or *.obj), sizing data (*.avs), pose (*.pos), motion (*.mtn), accessory (*.acc), bounding volume (*.pan), all avatar-related files such as arrangement points (*.arr) can be saved and loaded into one file (*.avt). ** Location** **Open/Add Avatar ** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open/Add ▶ **Avatar** ** ****Save Avatar ** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save As ▶ **Avatar** ** Operation** **Open/Add Avatar** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. → An open file window appears. 2. Select an avatar file. → Open/Add Avatar pop-up window appears. 3. Set the details and click **OK**. **Load Type****** | Open | Load your avatar. ---|---|--- Add | Add your avatar. Load as Morph Target | Load the avatar as a morph target. **Translation** | X | Move horizontally based on the center of the 3D garment window. Y | Move vertically based on the center of the 3D garment window. Z | Move forward and backward based on the center of the 3D garment window. Unit | Select the unit of travel distance. **📝****Note:** When adding an avatar, arrangement point is maintained individually for each avatar. (ver 2024.0) **Save Avatar** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. → An open file window appears. 2. Specify the location to save the garment file and enter a name and click **Save** to save it. **※ Note: ** * If multiple avatars are loaded, select one avatar and save it as an *.avt file. * When changing the file type to **Encrypted Avatar File(*.avte)** in the Avatar Save window, save it as an encrypted file that cannot be restored to other 3D files and avatar files (AVT). (ver 6.2)
content_description: This web page provides comprehensive instructions for opening, adding, and saving avatar files, along with details on file types and operational procedures for managing avatar-related data in a 3D environment.

title: [Popup] Copy/Paste Buttonhole
content: **List of Contents** Copy/Paste Buttonhole Input Interval/Number/Position to Copy/Paste Buttonhole ### ### **Objective** Copy and paste multiple buttonholes with keeping the interval space evenly. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button ** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005614447/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** **Operation** **Copy/Paste Buttonhole** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005614447/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** 2. Right click on an existing buttonhole, then select **Copy (Ctrl+C)** from the pop-up menu. 3. Right click again, then select **Paste (Ctrl+V)** from the pop-up menu. 4. Click on a desired place to locate the copy of the buttonhole. **Input Interval/Number/Position to Copy/Pase Buttonhole** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005614447/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** 2. Right click on an existing buttonhole, then select **Copy (Ctrl+C)** from the pop-up menu. 3. Right click again, then select **Paste (Ctrl+V)** from the pop-up menu. 4. Right click on a desired place to locate the copy of the buttonhole. →The Paste window appears. 5. Input desired value for interval/number of buttonholes/position. **Interval** | Sets the distance between buttonholes. ---|--- **Number of Buttons/Buttonholes** | Sets the number of buttonholes to copy/paste. **Position** | Sets the position of the center of the copied button/buttonhole from the left/right/top/bottom of the pattern outline (ver2.5.0). 6. Click **OK**. → The buttonholes are now being created and applied accordingly. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for copying and pasting multiple buttonholes in a design, ensuring even spacing and precise placement.

title: [Popup] Copy/Paste Button
content: **List of Contents** Copy/Paste Button Input Interval/Number/Position to Copy/Paste Button Duplicate Button to Symmetric Pattern ### **Objective** Copy and paste multiple buttons with keeping the interval space evenly or to Symmetric Patterns. **Location** Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button ** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005661288/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** **Operation** **Copy/Paste Button** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button ** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005661288/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** 2. Right click on an existing button, then select **Copy (Ctrl+C)**. 3. Right click the same button again, then select **Paste (Ctrl+V)**. 4. Click on a desired place to locate the copy of the button. **Input Interval/Number/Position to Copy/Paste Button** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button ** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005661288/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** 2. Right click on an existing button, then select **Copy (Ctrl+C)**. 3. Right click the same button again, then select **Paste (Ctrl+V)**. 4. Right click on a desired place to locate the copy of the button. →The Paste window appears. 5. Input desired value for Interval, Number of Buttons, and Position. **Interval** | Sets the distance between buttons. ---|--- **Number of Buttons/Buttonholes** | Sets the number of buttons to copy/paste. **Position** | Sets the position of the center of the copied button/buttonhole from the left/right/top/bottom of the pattern outline (ver2.5.0). 6. Click **OK**. → The buttons are now being created and applied accordingly. **Duplicate Button to Symmetric Pattern** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![____________.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115005661288/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** 2. Select a button to duplicate. → The selected button is now being highlighted in yellow color. 3. Right click on the selected button. → Pop-up menu appears. 4. Select **Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern** from the menu. → The selected button is now being duplicated at the same level. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for copying, pasting, and duplicating buttons with precise control over spacing and symmetry in your design projects.

title: [Property] Topstitch Corner Type
content: **List of Contents** Curved Corner Right Angled Corner **Objective** Set Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. **※ Note:** If stitch type is Overlock, set the corner type to Curved for smoother extension. **Location** Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Curved/Right Angled ▶ **On** / **Off** ### Operation **Curved Corner** 1. Select a Topstitch with ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005619787/_________.png) **Edit Topstitch** tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Curved ▶ **On** → The selected Topstitch is now being curved and smoothly extended. ![rightangledcorner.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115023689328/rightangledcorner.png) **Right Angled Corner** 1. Select a Topstitch with ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005619787/_________.png) **Edit Topstitch** tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Right Angled ▶ **On** → The selected topstitch is now being a right angle. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide on how to adjust topstitch corner types in the Topstitch Property Editor for smoother stitching at corners.

title: 현재 사용중인 컴퓨터 사양을 알고 싶어요
content: ## Question * 현재 사용중인 컴퓨터 사양을 어떻게 확인할 수 있을까요? * 컴퓨터에 이상이 없는지 어떻게 확인하나요? * 내 그래픽 카드가 무엇인지 알고 싶어요. ## Answer * 일반적으로 잘 알려진 방법은 내 컴퓨터 > 우클릭 메뉴 > 속성을 선택하는 것입니다. * '**컴퓨터에 대한 기본 정보 보기** ' 화면에서는 CPU, 메모리, Windows 버전을 쉽게 확인할 수 있습니다. * 그래픽카드 정보, 자가 진단과 같은 자세한 정보는 아래에서 확인하세요. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360056607314) \-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ## Windows 사용자 * 내 컴퓨터 > 속성 * 시스템 정보 (msinfo32) * 바탕화면 우클릭 > Nvidia 제어판 > 속성 * DirectX 진단 도구 * 써드파티 프로그램 사용 ## Mac 사용자 * [이 Mac에 관하여](https://support.apple.com/ko-kr/HT201260) * About this Mac ## 같이 보기 * CLO 컴퓨터 권장사양 * 최적의 그래픽카드 선택 * 그래픽카드 드라이버 설치하기
content_description: 이 페이지는 사용자가 자신의 컴퓨터 사양 및 그래픽 카드 정보를 확인하는 방법과 시스템 진단을 수행하는 방법을 안내합니다.

title: Adjust Trim Weight
content: **Adjust Trim Weight** \- Apply weight to an OBJ trim to simulate 3D garment drape influenced by the trim. \- Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Transform Pattern/ Edit Pattern \- 2D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003329708/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png)**Transform Pattern/![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003329728/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) Edit Pattern** \- Select the OBJ loaded as a trim. \- Its properties appear in the Property Editor. \- Simulate after entering the desired value to the Weight option. \- The trim weight is applied to the Simulation.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to guide users in adjusting the weight of an OBJ trim to accurately simulate the drape of 3D garments.

title: How can I import Xtex files?
content: **Question** How can I import Xtex files? **Answer** Please refer to the attached document on how to import Xtex files. Please be noted that .xtex file needs to be in a same folder with its textures like pictured below to prevent import issues: ![xtex_2.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360002193568/xtex_2.png)
